name: discover/discover-shell
title: DiscoverShell
summary: The frame of every public Discover site in the Mukoko family: skip link, mineral strip, a header (brand, main navigation, one action), the page in <main id="main">, and a footer. Only the brand changes between services.

props.name: homeLabel
props.description: The home link's accessible name, e.g. "mukoko circles, home".

props.name: nav
props.type: { label: string; href: string; current?: boolean | string }[]
props.description: The main navigation. `current` true (or "page") marks the current section.

props.name: footerLinks
props.type: { label: string; href: string; current?: boolean | string }[]

props.name: footerNote
props.description: One quiet line at the foot.

props.name: strip
props.description: The seven-mineral strip on the left edge.

slots.name: action
slots.expects: One primary action (a link styled as a button)
slots.description: The header's call to action, e.g. "Create a circle".

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Extra footer content, e.g. app-store badges.

behaviour: The skip link is first and targets <main id="main" tabindex="-1">.
The header holds the brand (a link home with an accessible name), the "Main" navigation and one action; on phones the navigation wraps onto its own row.
It goes inside <body>; the app owns <head> (use DiscoverMeta) and its stylesheets.

props.footerNote: Part of the Bundu ecosystem, built by Nyuchi Africa.

keyboard: Tab reaches the skip link first; Enter moves focus to <main>.
focus: The skip link appears on focus; every link shows the `--ring` focus outline.
aria: The home link is named by `homeLabel`; the navigations are "Main" and "Footer"; the current section has aria-current="page"; the mineral strip is aria-hidden.

theming.brandOverlay: The `brand` slot (the service's own mark) and whatever primary action the `action` slot holds. The frame, header, navigation and footer are identical in every brand.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: From 320px: the brand and the action share the first row; the navigation wraps onto a full-width row below 40rem.
The footer is one column, then three from 48rem.
contract:
contract
  slot is "discover-shell"
  uses mineral-strip
  a "All circles" min_height 44
  when default shows a "Create a circle"
  when default shows a "Skip to content"
  when bare shows h1 "Page"
end

checks.say: One main, the skip link's target.
The skip link comes first and targets main.
No navigation given, no navigation landmark.
